reels.caption:
Seaweed called Sargassum is one of the biggest reasons Tulum, Mexico is a ghost town in the summer of 2026, when it used to be one of the most famous digital nomad and expat hotspots.

This year, there's more of it than ever before. Scientists say 2026 is on track to be one of the worst years on record for Sargassum in the Mexican Caribbean.

It also impacts hotspots like Playa Del Carmen and Cancun, but Tulum gets it the worst, since it's right in the path of the currents that carry the seaweed over from the Atlantic Ocean.

I visited in late June and found nearly half of businesses in Tulum's hotel zone closed down, and the beaches completely unswimmable.

#sargassum #sargassummonitoring #tulum #tulummexico #sargassumseaweed
